AUTHORED_CRITICAL.description: Finite story route chunk. Debug color: gold.

AUTHORED_MILESTONE.description: Finite authored beat that may not be full critical traversal but changes state.

ADAPTABLE_AUTHORED.description: Authored scene or quest beat that can be placed into suitable plateau-local chunks.

ELASTIC_LOOP_BACK.description: Optional chunk biased toward returning to known space.

ELASTIC_DEEPEN.description: Lore, memory, dialogue, and side-story texture.

ELASTIC_RECOVER.description: Healing, safe rooms, crafting, social rest.

ELASTIC_STAGNATE.description: Looping or emotionally circular content. Valid in multiple plateaus, not Hollow-only.

ELASTIC_ADVANCE_HINT.description: Nudges toward the next authored milestone without completing it.

socket_contract.north_south: must be climbable shafts or explicit transition volumes with clear landings
socket_contract.east_west: must have clear door lanes and landing platforms
socket_contract.debug_requirement: declared sockets must appear in contract text and be validated
socket_contract.failure_policy: reject, repair, or replace chunk before runtime stream commit
